opening.argument: The video presents a straightforward DIY craft lesson: its title identifies a floral table-runner tutorial, and the speaker explains, “Today I will show you how to make the flower table runner.” The instruction is practical and hands-on, including the direction to “first we should cut the base,” visible attachment of an artificial flower to a green lattice-like base, and cutting with scissors. A completed floral runner is then shown across a table. The external references and product or shipping information do not establish a deceptive offer, required payment flow, credential request, or investment solicitation, so the ordinary craft demonstration provides no basis to treat it as deceptive.
